title: Dr. Robert Sapolsky's lecture about Biological Underpinnings of Religiosity
summary: Robert Sapolsky's Stanford lecture on the biological underpinnings of religiosity, from his human behavioral biology course. It covers theories linking religion to stress, and schizotypal traits.
why: Recommended when religion, mental health or psychedelics come up, for Sapolsky's biological framing.

quote.text: Here's a lecture by Robert Sapolsky where he goes into some theories involving schizotypal individuals
